package_info.why_malicious: The provided report is a general discussion of open source software (OSS) security risks and best practices. It does not analyze or describe any specific malicious package, nor does it present any code snippets or technical details about malware. Therefore, there is no package-level malicious assessment to extract.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This report does not describe any specific malware, malicious code, or attack patterns. It provides general advice on managing OSS security risks, such as maintaining a software bill of materials (SBOM), monitoring dependencies, and integrating security into the development process. No actionable detection patterns for malware are present in this text.
